attributes.name: id2
attributes.description: Id of the second body in this interaction.

attributes.name: cellDist
attributes.description: Distance of bodies in cell size units, if using periodic boundary conditions; id2 is shifted by this number of cells from its pos coordinates for this interaction to exist. Assigned by the collider. .. warning:: (internal) cellDist must survive Interaction::reset(), it is only initialized in ctor. Interaction that was cancelled by the constitutive law, was reset() and became only potential must have the period information if the geometric functor again makes it real. Good to know after few days of debugging that :-)

attributes.name: iterBorn
attributes.description: Step number at which the interaction was added to simulation.

attributes.name: isReal
attributes.description: True if this interaction has both geom and phys; False otherwise.

attributes.name: isActive
attributes.description: True if this interaction is active. Otherwise the forces from this interaction will not be taken into account. True by default.
